title: Lab 1: the bench
task: Before any authentication, the switch needs a name, the VLANs the roles will land in, and a way to reach ClearPass. Name it access-01. Make VLAN 10 STAFF and VLAN 20 PRINTERS. Put 1/1/1 to 1/1/8 in VLAN 10 as access ports, then move 1/1/5 to VLAN 20. Add the RADIUS server 192.0.2.10 with the shared secret cppm-lab-key, put it in a server group called CLEARPASS, and save with write memory.
hints: hostname, vlan, name, interface, vlan access, radius-server host, aaa group server radius, server, write memory. ? after any of them shows what comes next.
A range is one interface line: interface 1/1/1-1/1/8.
The server has to exist (radius-server host) before a group can list it (server 192.0.2.10 inside the group).

checks.desc: 1/1/1 is an access port in VLAN 10
1/1/8 is an access port in VLAN 10
RADIUS server 192.0.2.10 configured with a key
